Terms of Service

Last updated: October 2024

By booking event decoration services with Balloon Galaxy, you agree to the following terms and conditions.

1. Bookings & Deposits

A deposit is required to secure your date. Dates are held on a first-come, first-served basis across Birmingham, Coventry, and the West Midlands.

2. Prop Hire & Collection

All reusable props, including backdrop boards, sailboards, metal hoop frames, plinths, and 4ft LED numbers remain the property of Balloon Galaxy. We will collect these post-event at the agreed time.

3. Venue Access

Clients are responsible for ensuring our team has safe, timely venue access for setup prior to guest arrival.
